headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate machine learning models to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansion. Leverage natural language processing for improved documentation parsing and user guidance.
actions: Implement an AI model to analyze package metadata and community feedback to flag potential security vulnerabilities or compatibility issues before installation.
